title: Dataset: Variation in Inconel 718 powder properties by collection location and reuse cycle in laser powder bed fusion
description:
Measurement data from a 13-job laser powder bed fusion campaign on an SLM 280 system in which one 100 kg batch of gas-atomised Inconel 718 powder was reused for eight cycles and sampled at five fixed locations: the recoater side (Zone 1), three positions in the build chamber along the shielding-gas flow (Zones 2 to 4) and the sieve reject (Zone 5).

Contents: raw X-ray diffraction scans (Rigaku MiniFlex, Cu K-alpha; .rasx, .csv and instrument reports) of nine powder samples; energy-dispersive X-ray spectroscopy element tables of twelve zone and cycle combinations; four SEM fields (x150) with particle-by-particle contour annotations in six morphology classes and the derived per-particle equivalent diameter, circularity, elongation and convexity; SEM micrographs (x150 and x1000) of the five collection zones at several reuse cycles; Hall, Carney and Gustavsson funnel flow times; exported melt-pool monitoring maps of one layer at reuse 0, 1, 7 and 8 and the emission statistics read from them; Vickers microhardness of parts built at reuse 0 to 8; and the MATLAB script that generates the data figures of the associated article.

The particle annotations were produced with PowderAnnotator (https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20628158).
